subject: Decision: AutoML-Zero graduates to a scoped H2 extension
body:
Team,

Decision from the 5/20 review, confirmed with Hana today: AutoML-Zero graduates, but as a scoped extension rather than a full program. The "batch lottery" framing landed - we fund discovery sprints per task family at ~$9k per useful candidate, not a standing service.

Staffing for the extension phase is settled: Oyin Iversen stays committed at 60% to AutoML-Zero for all of July 2026 to harden the search infrastructure, with Katya at 30% for reviews. Freya rotates to advisory. Paloma rolls off entirely at end of May - thank you for the tooling work, it's what made 20-seed sweeps cheap.

Jelena will file the H2 headcount plan before the Q3 OKR lock on 6/26. I'll write the one-page graduation memo this week.

Anders
